# Submarius

> The only ocean-conditions app that tells you when to go. Real water-clarity forecasts, honest bite scores, and a single GO/NO verdict per dive day — for spearos, divers, anglers, and boaters.

Submarius aggregates NOAA marine forecasts, Open-Meteo, USGS river-discharge data, and NOAA CoastWatch Kd490 satellite turbidity into a transparent, physically-grounded model. Every factor is tappable for its full reasoning — no black-box AI claims. Safety features (OCEARCH tagged-shark alerts, SOS, buddy GPS) are permanently free regardless of subscription tier. Pro is $12.99/mo, $99/yr, or $149 lifetime.

## Core product

- [Home](https://submarius.com/): What Submarius is and how the verdict works
- [Spearfishing app](https://submarius.com/spearfishing-app): Conditions, water clarity, and verdict for spearos and freedivers
- [Fishing app](https://submarius.com/fishing-app): Bite score, tides, and 8-day marine forecast for anglers
- [Water clarity forecast explained](https://submarius.com/clarity): How the Submarius clarity model works — Kd490 satellite turbidity, river-plume detection, wave-mixing physics, post-dive viz reports
- [Bite score explained](https://submarius.com/bite-score): What the 0–10 number means, the signals it uses, why most other bite scores are wrong

## Comparisons

- [Submarius vs Fishbrain](https://submarius.com/vs/fishbrain): Verdict-first decision app vs catch-logging database
- [Submarius vs Windy](https://submarius.com/vs/windy): Marine-specific verdict vs general weather visualization
- [Submarius vs Surfline](https://submarius.com/vs/surfline): Forecast verdict + permanently-free safety features vs cam network
- [Submarius vs Navionics](https://submarius.com/vs/navionics): Conditions intelligence vs nautical charts
- [Submarius vs FishTrack](https://submarius.com/vs/fishtrack): Coastal verdict vs offshore SST charts
